from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyExpenseRecord(BaseModel):
    """Financial expense data extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company or registrant name found in the document")
    expense_category: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label for the expense (e.g., 'General and administrative')")
    expense_value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical amount of the expense as reported in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the value (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The time period covered by the financial statement")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expense_records: list[CompanyExpenseRecord]
